items.t: A human with one clearly non human feature, drawn matter of factly.
An elf: taller, finer boned, long ears, otherwise unremarkable.
A dwarf: shorter, broader, heavy brow, strong hands.
An orc: heavy jaw, thick neck, tusks that sit naturally in the mouth.
A beast folk: a recognisable animal head on a human frame, drawn as a person rather than a costume.
An android: seams at the joints, matte surfaces, a face that still expresses.
